_batch: Phase 2 batch 3 — D/E across ten more covered types
_note: DRAFTED. The thinnest batch so far, and correctly: several of these types have almost no protective devices and little to record. Not padded.
subject: WATER METERS
_sparse_note: A meter is an instrument, not a machine. It has nothing to trip. Its start-up is a reading and a zero.

items.label: Bypass arrangement proven — meter can be isolated without loss of service
items.convergence_reason: FIRM PRACTICE — fifty years of Isotherm field practice, cited as the anchor because the code set is silent here. Not dressed as a standard. The bypass is the only thing on a meter installation that behaves like a protective device.

_ratification_note: Batch 3 ratified as drafted, no amendments. Instrument-shaped tables endorsed; all four scope boundaries approved as the placement and 7b laws applying themselves.
